extracted.name: Suzy's Special Red Quinoa
extracted.description: This easy quinoa side dish simmers red quinoa with beef bouillon, Chinese five-spice powder, and ginger for a flavorful, aromatic side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup red quinoa, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Combine water, Chinese five-spice powder, butter, bouillon, ginger, and black pepper in a saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil and stir until bouillon dissolves. Add quinoa, reduce heat to a simmer, and cover. Cook until liquid is absorbed and quinoa is tender, about 20 minutes. Fluff with a fork before serving.
